name: nova_canvas_generate
description: Generate a brand new image from a text prompt using Amazon Nova Canvas. The image is saved to S3 and a presigned URL is returned. Supports optional style, dimensions, and negative prompts.

prompt.description: The text prompt describing the image to generate

style.description: Style preset for the image, e.g. '3d animated family film', 'design sketch', 'flat vector illustration', 'graphic novel', 'maximalism', 'midcentury retro', 'soft digital painting' (optional)

negative_prompt.description: What to avoid in the generated image (optional)
